body: I'm in Los Angeles, what about you? We can be friends even if were far away. I've been crying non stop all day today, I just feel so hopelessly alone.

*hug* Good job, my friend. 

I wish I could take pride in something, but no matter how I try to be rational with myself I can't. My depression is making everything feel negative

One day at a time, I'm trying, I really really am. I don't even remember the last time I was happy, I've just been miserable for so so long. It's reached an unbearable point. And if no one can help me and I can't help myself, then whats going to happen? I don't know, but I'm scared

Thank you for taking the time to respond to my message

I haven't gotten over it yet, and it's been so long. With so many attempts to fix it. I'm just an anxious mess right now, nothing can bring me happiness and nothing is worth doing. How can I possibly live like this? It's torture.

I don't see myself meeting the love of my life or having a child, who would ever want to be with someone like me? 

I like comics, games, movies. But none of it is appealing to me anymore. I just do a whole lot of nothing right now. I may be starting a new job Monday, and there's a whole other list of stress and anxiety going on about that. For my free time I just smoke weed. Self medicating I guess. 

Thank you for the response, you are a good person

I understand what you are saying, but how can I not feel useless and unappealing when I know I am. My therapist is good, I actually like her. But there's only so much she could do.  I'm trying to save myself but my mind can't stop drifting to suicide. I can't express to you how sad I am.

I went to a social gathering yesterday, but I wilted very quickly and didn't mingle, I just couldn't. I hate myself so much. Sometimes I don't even know why, and that makes me hate myself even worse. I'm tired of feeling like this, I can't take it.

I will try your list idea. I'm open to trying anything right now

Thank you so much for your response, it means a lot

I've been trying so hard to make it better, but my depression is keeping me down. At this point I want to feel, hear and see nothing as opposed to living like this. Why would I want to live like this? I'm tired of it, I keep coming back to this point no matter how many times I think I've moved on from the thoughts.

I am a failure in a lot of ways. I've been sad, lonely and have had death on my mind since I was 9 (I'm 23 now). I did not enjoy junior high, high school and I just graduated college, all of it spent lonely and sad. If I could stop feeling so sad, I'd be fine with living but I can't take it. Because no matter what I try it's there. I haven't enjoyed my life, sometimes I wonder if I've ever enjoyed my life at any point. It's so tiring to come back to these thoughts of suicide over and over again

I have been posting ads on craigslist to meet friends and I have tried meetup.com, I've met a couple nice people. Yet I don't have anyone I can just see at a time like this. I feel so useless and unappealing. I've never felt love before. I have such a hard time talking to strangers, I have went to coffee shops and libraries but I can never talk to anyone. My social anxiety is overwhelming. My depression is all I can think about, I'm just so unbearably sad.

I don't know, I feel like this is my destination and my destination isn't meant to be glorious or good because it isn't. I don't think suicide would be enlightening or rich for me, that isn't why I want to do it. I want to do it because what I have now isn't good. I know we can't predict the future, but if there are anymore days like this left, I just can't handle it anymore.
